text: A translation of this book by Enno Littmann was used in a study identifying patterns of framing in it by Mia Gerhardt. The character Juan Dahlmann is continually thwarted in his attempts to read this book in Borges' story The South. In this book, three days are given to a court official to solve the murder-mystery of "The Three Apples."
